On March 9, 2020, the Judge's financial advisor mistakenly purchased stock in Gilead Science, Inc. (GILD) and Carnival Corporation (CCL).  Upon learning of
 the mistaken purchases, the Judge instructed her financial advisor to sell the stock immediately.  The Gilead Science stock was sold on March 9, and the Carnival
 Corporation stock was sold on March 10. All losses associated with these stock transactions will be credited to the Judge's account. The Judge's financial advisor
 has been instructed to refrain from purchasing individual stocks. 
The mutual fund now known as "Vaneck Vectors Gold ETF" was referred to as "Market Vectors Gold ETF" in prior disclosures.
